up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows matching the following criteria. Target: Human single-protein target CHEMBL2150837 (ATPase family AAA domain-containing protein 2). Activity Type: IC50. Value Constraint: Exact standard relation '=' with non-null pChEMBL values. Output Columns: Assay ChEMBL ID, Target Type, Tax ID, Canonical SMILES, Molecule ChEMBL ID, Standard Type, pChEMBL Value. Ordering: Sort by Molecule ChEMBL ID, then by Assay ChEMBL ID. Limit: 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM assays ass
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2150837'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
